description: This file contains unit tests for the CatalogFilterSpecification class in the application core of the eShopOnWeb project. It defines test methods to verify filtering behavior based on brand and type IDs, using Xunit framework for testing.

classes.name: CatalogFilterSpecification
classes.description: Unit test class for CatalogFilterSpecification, testing item filtering logic based on specified criteria.

methods.name: MatchesExpectedNumberOfItems
methods.description: Parameterized test method that verifies the number of items returned by the CatalogFilterSpecification based on different brand and type IDs.

methods.name: GetTestItemCollection
methods.description: Provides a fixed collection of CatalogItem objects used as test data for filtering tests.
